name: iboardz-store-backend
description: Dependency-free backend for the iBoardz storefront and dashboard

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const f=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())return e.name==='node_modules'||e.name==='.git'?[]:walk(f);return e.isFile()&&f.endsWith('.js')?[f]:[]});for(const root of ['.','../store-dashboard']){for(const f of walk(root)){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status)process.exit(r.status||1)}}"
